79: (Bamidbar 10:30) "And he said to him: I will not go; but to my land and to my kindred I will go": He said to him: Both because of my land and because of my kindred I will not go (with you). There are some who have a land, but no possessions; others who have possessions, but no family. But I have a land, possessions, and family, and I was a priest in my land. If I will not go (home) because of my land, I will go because of my possessions; and if I will not go because of my possessions, I will go because of my family.
